name: Deck Suggestions
author: eruizimade
summary: Load a track and see the five best tracks to play next, suggested by Backspins on your computer over your network.
description:
When a deck loads a track, from a USB stick or from rekordbox over Pro DJ Link, a panel shows the five best follow-ups with BPM, key and why, picked by Backspins (the rekordbox toolkit) from your own sets. Tracks that play for 45 seconds are sent back so they teach it.

Needs Backspins with Deck link on, on the same network. Uses the network only to reach it. Changes no control, audio or library.
